before_record.title: Integer oblique paired maps with an explicit nineteen-scalar repair
before_record.statement: Over every field, explicit integer local maps give Q(n,b) to M(n-1,4,n-1)-E for b>=2 and n>=b+1. With r=n-1 and d=r-b>0, the actual residual has exact flattening ranks (r^2-b^2,2r+d,2r+d) and an explicit scalar decomposition with 4*r*d terms. When d=0 the residual vanishes. When d=1, two binary-convolution cores improve the decomposition to 4*r-1 terms. In particular Q(6,4) direct sum D_19 restricts to M(5,4,5), with residual ranks (9,11,11) and three support-piece ranks (4,2,8),(4,8,2),(1,4,4). The supplied oblique long maps force the first residual rank r^2-b^2 for every first map. Complete rational source contractions, scalar-term replays and support factorizations accompany both finite witnesses and family controls.
